description: This file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter subclass called DaysAdapter, responsible for displaying daily weather forecast data in an Android weather application. It fetches weather data from a remote API using Volley, parses JSON responses, and updates UI components with weather details such as temperature, pressure, wind speed, humidity, and weather icons.

classes.name: DaysAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for binding daily weather forecast data to a RecyclerView in an Android weather app.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DayViewHolder by inflating the layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds weather data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items (days) to display.

methods.name: getDailyWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches weather data for a specific day from a remote API and updates the UI.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the ViewHolder UI elements with fetched weather data.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the loading spinner and displays the weather info layout.

inner_class.name: DayViewHolder
inner_class.description: ViewHolder class holding references to UI elements for each day item.
